messages:
maria_cust: Hi team — we migrated our account retention from 365 -> 90 days on 2026-02-01. I'm still seeing audit logs and message transcripts older than 90 days via the /v1/logs API. Can someone confirm the deletion timeline?

alex_support: sorry you're hitting this, thanks for flagging. Can you share an example request+id that returns an older item? Also which org id?

maria_cust: org: acme-marketing, sample log id: log_20250115_45f. I can DM full JSON if needed. We updated retention in console under Settings -> Data Retention.

alex_support: got it. quick checks i'll run: retention policy lookup, scheduled purge job status, and any legal-hold flags. one sec.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job 'data-retention-purge' started at 2026-03-02T03:00:00Z on region-us-west-2.

alex_support: retention policy for org acme-marketing shows custom retention = 90 days (applied 2026-02-01). No active legal-hold flags in UI.

alex_support: however I see the relevant objects are in the cold-archive bucket (arn:aws:s3:::redwood-cold-us-west-2) with lifecycle policy to expire in 2 years. suspect migration pipeline archived older logs before policy change. escalating to security for KMS/encryption interplay.

sam_security: looping in security. Quick Q: were those logs re-encrypted with a new KMS key or moved under a different key alias around the time of migration? If so, object deletion via our purge job could have skipped them due to key access mismatch.

maria_cust: we rotated KMS keys in Jan per our policy, but that was for their infra. We didn't touch Redwood keys. Not sure if the migration touched server-side encryption.

alex_support: repro steps I ran: 1) GET /v1/logs?org=acme-marketing&before=2026-01-01 returns entries including log_20250115_45f 2) Inspect object metadata: x-retention-policy: 90, x-archived: true, x-original-retention-set: 365 3) purge job lists this object as skip: 'object locked by kms:AccessDenied'

sam_security: that's the clue. If the purge worker can't decrypt metadata because the key alias changed or IAM role lost decrypt permission, it will skip deletion and leave object intact. We need to check KMS key rotation events and role attachments for the purge worker service principal.

jess_oncall: I'm checking audit logs for key events. I see a key rotation event for alias/rdw-logs on 2026-01-20 and a policy change on 2026-01-22 removing a grant that allowed the purge service principal to decrypt.

alex_support: thanks jess. action plan: (1) grant temporary decrypt permission back to purge worker role so it can finish the backlog purge; (2) run targeted purge for org acme-marketing only after a small rollback window; (3) schedule customer-facing confirmation and share a mitigation ETA.

sara_legal: quick note from legal: verify there's no outstanding legal hold from our internal litigation tracker before deleting older records. If legal hold exists, we must not purge.

sam_security: confirmed: no legal holds for acme-marketing. I'll re-apply the grant for 24h and monitor.

deploy-bot: Grant applied to role 'service-data-purge' for alias/rdw-logs.

alex_support: running targeted purge now: command used:
```
POST /internal/admin/purge
{ 'org': 'acme-marketing', 'before': '2026-01-01', 'force': true }
```
Progress: 0/842 objects deleted (skips due to kms error expected to drop).

deploy-bot: Purge job 'targeted-purge-acme-marketing' completed: 842 objects processed, 837 deleted, 5 skipped (manual review).

alex_support: deletion complete for most items. The 5 skipped are multipart archived objects that need a different workflow. I'm escalating to infra for multipart cleanup.

maria_cust: thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. Can you confirm how long it will take for APIs to stop returning the older entries? We still see a few references.

alex_support: those remaining references are index entries; search index needs to be rebuilt for that org. I've kicked an index refresh job. Expect results to clear within 2 hours.

jess_oncall: index refresh job started.

alex_support: follow-up: root cause summary for you: (A) historical logs were migrated to cold-archive with a longer bucket lifecycle before retention policy change; (B) a KMS grant change prevented the purge worker from decrypting metadata and deleting objects; (C) after temporary grant we were able to purge ~99.4% of backlog; (D) multipart objects require infra intervention.

alex_support: remediation steps we've taken: restored grant, executed targeted purge, kicked index refresh, opened infra ticket #INF-4921 for multipart cleanup, and added a monitoring alert to catch future kms-related purge failures.

maria_cust: perfect. please send a note to our security contact once multipart cleanup completes. thanks!

sam_security: will send confirmation once INF-4921 is resolved and S3 objects are fully removed.

sara_legal: confirmed no legal hold.

alex_support: closing loop: last api check at 2026-03-02T07:30:00Z shows no logs older than 90 days returned for acme-marketing. If you still see anything, DM me the id. :thumbsup:

maria_cust: verified on our side. all good. thanks everyone :tada:
